statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one CVE whose vendor or product field names Check Point, with a date-added value between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains an entry whose vendorProject or product names Check Point with dateAdded between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming Check Point carries a dateAdded inside 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-31.

statement: Front-month NYMEX WTI crude settles at or above 110.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-16. Reference: 100.05 on the packet date 2026-09-12.
resolution: TRUE if any CME front-month WTI settlement between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-16 is 110.00 or higher. Reference 100.05 at seal.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement in the window prints below 110.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: The FRED series DGS10 records a value at or above 5.25 percent on at least one business day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 4.97 percent on the packet date 2026-09-12.
resolution: TRUE if any DGS10 observation dated 2026-09-14 through 2026-11-13 is 5.25 or higher. Reference 4.97 percent at seal.
failure_condition: No DGS10 observation in the window reaches 5.25 percent.

statement: The S&P 500 closes below 7,200.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 7,656.98 on the packet date 2026-09-12.
resolution: TRUE if any S&P 500 daily close between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-13 prints below 7,200.00 per S&P Dow Jones Indices. Reference 7,656.98 at seal.
failure_condition: Every S&P 500 daily close in the window holds at or above 7,200.00.

statement: Saudi Aramco or the Saudi energy ministry announces resumption of flows on the pipeline shut after the 2026-09-12 drone attack, with the announcement falling between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters and at least one of BBC or Al Jazeera report an official Saudi announcement of resumed flows on that pipeline dated 2026-09-14 through 2026-10-16.
failure_condition: Flows on that pipeline are not officially announced as resumed at any point inside the window.

statement: Non-Houthi forces hold Mayun Island in the Bab al-Mandab strait at some point between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if two of Reuters, AP, BBC and Al Jazeera report that Yemeni government, coalition or other non-Houthi forces control Mayun Island during the window.
failure_condition: Houthi forces retain control of Mayun Island for the entire window.

statement: The UN Security Council adopts a resolution whose subject is Iran at a meeting held between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the UN Security Council resolutions register lists a resolution adopted 2026-09-14 through 2026-11-20 whose subject is Iran or the Iran nuclear file.
failure_condition: No Iran-subject Security Council resolution is adopted inside the window.

statement: Either chamber of the US Congress records a roll call vote on a joint resolution invoking the War Powers Resolution with respect to Iran, held between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: TRUE if Congress.gov shows a recorded House or Senate roll call between 2026-09-14 and 2026-12-11 on a War Powers joint resolution concerning hostilities involving Iran.
failure_condition: Neither chamber records such a roll call vote inside the window.

statement: At least one of the six Nigerian nationals extradited to the United States over a 6 million dollar online romance scam enters a guilty plea between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if the US district court docket in that prosecution records a guilty plea by any of the six defendants entered between 2026-09-14 and 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: None of the six defendants has a guilty plea docketed inside the window.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one magnitude 7.0 or greater earthquake worldwide with origin time between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-24.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query returns at least one event of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-24 inclusive.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog holds no event of magnitude 7.0 or greater for the window.
